SYNTHETIX GOVERNANCE

Protocol Governance

The Synthetix protocol is governed by a decentralized set of representative councils that are voted on by stakers. The protocol and ecosystem is more broadly maintained and improved by a combination of core contributors, ecosystem partners, and community members.
